summary: The body clip each bending move casts with (BendPoses.pick; SwayPose plays it for the player, NpcBody.play_cast for a bot), and when its strike leaves (strike_s: SwayCaster lands a bolt, a throw, a cone, a ring or a shove then). Only in element mode (a duel or a ring match with the player's element chosen): the open world keeps the mastery tier clips (SwayPose.clip_for). Our own clips only (docs/animation_provenance.md, animations/SOURCE.md): no imported clip, nothing measured off a reference (fit_ref.gd). Until the own bending clips land (animations_extra/Frontier_Bend.res: tools/anim_author/blender/bend_clips.py, element by element), the existing own clips stand in.

_doc.pick: BendPoses.pick(move, mode, element): moves[move].modes[mode], else moves[move].pose, else cast[element] (only for a move with a bend spec for that mode: the Sway's old spells keep their tier clip unless mapped here), else {} (the caller plays SwayPose.clip_for). A clip missing from every own library, or in exclude, is passed over to the next.
_doc.pose: A clip's name, or {clip, mask, hand, root, alt, hold_s, strike_s, back_s, legs_always}; what it leaves out comes from clips[clip], then the clip's own metas.
_doc.clips: Timing and play rules for clips whose library does not carry them (the interim clips were made before strike_s): hold_s (the moment held while the lock fills), strike_s (the moment the move leaves, on the release's clip), back_s (where a broken lock eases out from), hand (the limb the move leaves from: l_palm, r_palm, both, l_foot, r_foot), mask (ToolPose: upper, reach_l, reach_r, full), root (the caster held still while it plays), then (a release played as another clip: the floor cast's press then its stand), press_s (a bot plays the whole clip: its strike there).
_doc.stance: Each element's stance loop (empty until the own stances exist).
_doc.combo_window_s: Casts this close chain (a pose's alt: the next hand).

exclude_why.own-axe-d: data/anim_author/axe_swings.json axe_d has a 'fit' record: its key poses were measured off atk-pipe-1-side-swing-intro/-miss (tools/anim_author/fit_ref.gd); the clip's own 'source' meta says so
exclude_why.own-axe-w: axe_w has a 'fit' record: measured off atk-pipe-3-to-knee-hit-intro/-hit (fit_ref.gd)
exclude_why.own-axe-parry: tools/anim_author/author_parry.gd builds every key from axe_d's first key (guard.duplicate(true), only the hips' and chest's yaw and the tool changed), and that key is one of the fitted ones; the clip's 'source' meta reads 'none: not extracted from any game', which does not record that input. Held back until the owner decides (2026-10-04, T4)
exclude_why.own-axe-block-high: tools/anim_author/author_high_block.gd starts and ends on axe_d's first key, a fitted pose (as the parry); held back until the owner decides
exclude_why.own-club-stab: tools/anim_author/author_thrust.gd takes the club's grip from axe_d's first key's tool (a fitted pose); own-axe-stab, whose grip comes from the carry clip instead, stands in for it

_own_bend: The first ten own ring-sport clips (animations_extra/Frontier_Bend.res, tools/anim_author/blender/bend_clips.py; awaiting the owner's approval, wired where they fit, none authored for this): their timing (hold_s, strike_s, back_s, up_s) is the clips' own metas; the rows above only name the limb the game knows (the clips say r, l, both, foot_r), the mask (the casts on the upper body with the legs as far as the caster stands still; the stomp and the knocks whole) and that no clip roots but the stomp. The earth stomp poses the stomp and quake-like moves (Rock Jab stomp, Earth Wall shell, Earth Grip), the earth push the pushes (Earth Shove push and split), the earth rise what comes up (Rock Jab kick-up, Earth Wall column, Pillar); the throws pose the throw-style moves until the throws of their own come (Stone spike and boulder overhand, disc sidearm, pebbles underhand; Ice spear overhand, shards sidearm; Fire Blast punch overhand), each with its mirrored twin as the next hand (alt). The knocks are SwayPose's knock layer, not casts. Earth Wall wall keeps the floor cast (tests/bending/test_bend_poses.gd holds it).
